author: Zegita
body:
IGN: Zegita

Why I was banned?:

 Hello guys guess what I just got unbanned a few weeks ago and I've just been banned AGAIN by the staff member Iron who is a moderator. I believe this is an abuse of staff as he used no evidence to ban me nothing it simply said "You have been punished by IRON for Hacking(Kill Aura) on May 15, 2015 8:03:20 GMT. Before he banned me for "hacks" I was killing a guy called Lokigh who I believe was saying that I was hacking because I was killing him too much when playing Control the Hill.
Why I feel I should be unbanned from the server?: 

 Honestly, I am WILLING to screenshare ANY senior mod or higher than Iron to show that I do not have any form of hacks. I even said before in my appeal that I stopped with the hacks because I believe it is just futile. The fact that was no evidence given and the fact that my friend tried to negotiate with Iron to say "May Zegita please screenshare you" reveals that it was a futile attempt to try and be unbanned. If this member of staff is treating players like this what about the other players who have been banned like this. I respect your server but this cannot be right ok, I am a LEGIT person and I always get hackusated a lot. If you want FURTHER PROOF that I do not hack then go to my channel https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCyUTAatWzU92DNOUd7BD1Zw :).

Furthermore there are other players on other servers who know I do not hack(members of staff) and please just if any of you mods are willing just for a few moments I will show you I do not hack and I will screenshare I promise. The player Lokigh, who is a Gold rank,  might of told the moderator Iron to watch me for a few seconds but that is not a very long time is it? What I am trying to say is that why the hell would I start "HACKING" again on a server that I have played for 2 or 3 odd years now. Please understand this action, there was no evidence of me hacking just an "eye witness" probably according to the moderator just because the way I play and that I was simply beating everybody else. The fact that the moderator did not want to see me screenshare my Minecraft and tells me to appeal reveals that he is merely not willing to respect or help me. If you want even more further proof ask your trustworthy ranker Somali_Captain who has played the server just as much as me and is an Emerald and knows I do not hack :). Thank you for reading this and I respect the decision you will make. Thank you :)
